title.zh: Strategy计划通过优先股融资增持比特币，Saylor称最高可创造300亿美元数字信贷
title.en: Strategy计划通过优先股融资增持比特币，Saylor称最高可创造300亿美元数字信贷

current_state.zh: On Strategy's Q3 earnings call, Michael Saylor said the company could create up to $30 billion in 'digital credit' from its balance sheet—including via STRC preferred stock—to buy more bitcoin without issuing common equity, as the firm reported 848,517 BTC held and announced a CFO transition.
